system.description: Dark Host: When you use the Dark Passenger class feature, you invite a fraction of that Entity into your body and let it seize partial control of it. You gain the Vessel benefit of that Entity.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist

system.gmNotes: Each Entity's Vessel benefit is in its description in the TNU Adversaries compendium, folder "Entities of Void"; it is applied by hand.
